levels.surface: محمد بن الحسن بن أحمد بن الوليد

notes: Rule 11: the Imam Abu al-Hasan Musa b. Ja'far (عليهما السلام) speaks and acts inside the scene the chain reports; whether he is a source or only in the scene is not settled, so he is not written as a link.
«أخيه الحسين» and «أبيه علي بن يقطين» are written as the name alone (rule 7). «الشيخ» in «الشيخ أبو جعفر» is a title, left out.
